adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` the only explicit authorization filter added is `before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff` (no `ensure_admin`). That means moderators (“staff”) would be allowed to create/update/destroy `EmbeddableHost` records unless some other layer (e.g. `AdminConstraint` or `Admin::AdminController`) further restricts access. The finding’s phrasing that admin-only access “relies solely on the route AdminConstraint” isn’t strictly true because the controller does enforce `ensure_staff`, but the underlying concern—this endpoint is not clearly admin-only in-controller—is diff-grounded and actionable as an authorization/scope concern.
